title: 凯特琳·高窗守望
description: 凯特琳穿完整紫蓝长外套，在高窗走廊静立，长枪枪口向下安全垂持，高帽与长发构成利落轮廓。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Caitlyn is an adult Piltover woman with long dark blue hair, clear blue eyes, a structured tall hat, and refined tailored clothing. Preserve the purple-blue and gold costume silhouette through a fully covering high-collared coat, opaque trousers or tights, gloves, and boots. Her distinctive precision rifle is held low with the muzzle directed at empty ground, finger away from the trigger and no aiming.
art_direction.scene: Frame her in a three-quarter standing pose along a monumental window corridor, shoulders level and gaze focused past the camera rather than down the weapon. Clear separation between rifle, coat, and legs keeps the silhouette readable. Hard window light forms long floor rectangles, with rich wax-crayon shadows, distant pale rooftops, and minimal architectural ornament behind her.
art_direction.palette: ink blue, dusty violet, pale gold, warm limestone
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
